variants.name: Extended Magazine
variants.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

variants.name: 9x18mm 7N25
variants.info:
For 9x18mm firearms.
Changes your ammunition to the 7N25 variant.
Increases torso damage multiplier (+10%) but also significantly increases bullet velocity (+50%) and penetration (+140%) while cutting down overall damage & range (-10%) and head damage multiplier (-7.5%).
